editorial:
Imagine your favorite childhood story turned into a total nightmare. You get a version of Pinocchio who isn't looking for a magic wish, but is instead obsessed with becoming human by any means necessary. He has a mean cricket in his ear telling him to do terrible things, and he is jealous of his brother James, who is already a real boy. The vibe is dark, creepy, and full of blood, making it feel more like a slasher movie than a fairy tale. It is a wild ride that takes a sweet story and flips it on its head to scare you.

You will love the practical effects and the way the tension builds up before the big kills. Some parts of the plot move a bit slow, but the shocks make up for it. If you like movies that take old stories and make them scary, you need to see this. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, so try to stream it that way for the best picture. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move so you can rewatch the best scenes.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Pinocchio tries to carve the skin and organs out of James to finish his transformation. Just as he thinks he has won, Geppetto reveals he kept a kill switch in the puppet's chest. Geppetto flips the switch, and Pinocchio freezes in place. The movie ends with the cricket laughing as the puppet is thrown into a fire, showing that the evil voice never really cared about him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisted versions of classic stories and gory horror movies.
